_comment: NOT APPLIED. Cloudflare WAF custom rule (Free plan allows 5) for zone 712c61fe6e7e08f8123082b3fa54a2fb (teamlancaster.com). Apply via dashboard (Security > WAF > Custom rules) or: PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/712c61fe6e7e08f8123082b3fa54a2fb/rulesets/phases/http_request_firewall_custom/entrypoint with {"rules": [...]} — NOTE: that PUT replaces ALL existing custom rules in the phase; list them first (GET same URL) and merge. Needs a token with Zone > Zone WAF: Edit. Search engines (Googlebot, Bingbot) are deliberately NOT blocked so they can fetch pages and see noindex. Also turn on Security > Bots > 'Block AI bots' (API: PUT /zones/{zone_id}/bot_management {"ai_bots_protection":"block"}, needs Zone > Bot Management: Edit).
